div.head: Cn 1018 21
div.ab: And gemeta 7 gewihta rihte man georne. 7 ælces unrihtes heonan forð geswice.
And gemeta and gewihta rihte man georne, and ælces unrihtes heonan forð geswice.
And measures and weights should be diligently corrected, and every misdeed cease at once.
And weights and measures are to be assiduously made right, and all unlawful practices abolished henceforth.
